{{Quote
|For her, you would seek Pharloom's many fabulous bugs and cut them.
Cut them with your blade! Cut them with your mature spirit! Cut them with your savage adult heart!
Would you help Nuu? Could you take her scroll, and fill its pages with the learnings of your cuts?
|[[Nuu]]
|Hr=SS}}

The <b>Hunter's Journal</b> is a compendium of every [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemy]] found in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. New entries are added to the Journal after defeating new enemies. A few entries can only be obtained by inspecting a specific object or as a reward for completing a challenge. 

== Use ==
Defeating a specified number of each enemy completes the journal, unlocking additional notes from [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] about that enemy, as well as some lore and techniques for fighting that enemy.

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Nuu]] in the Halfway Home in [[Greymoor]].  When it is inspected, the Journal can be found as a pane in the Menu. 

{{Gallery
|Image1 =Mapshot SS Hunter's Journal.png!Location in Greymoor
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Greymoor 06.png!Nuu inside Halfway Home in Greymoor
}}

== Hunter's Journal entries ==
A total of 236 entries can be acquired for the Hunter's Journal in <abbr title="The default game mode.">Classic Mode</abbr> (and 237 in {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]).
	
See the entry list for the 6 entries not required for the <i>True Hunter</i> [[Achievements (Silksong)|achievement]] or obtaining the [[Hunter's Memento]]. The [[Summoned Saviour]] entry is exclusive to {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], and is required for the Hunter's Memento in Steel Soul savefiles.

In order to see the number of creatures encountered and the total number required to complete the journal, the [[Farsight]] item must be constructed. This item will also add grey slots in the places that unencountered enemies necessary for the [[Hunter's Memento]] would occupy. Entries which are not required do not have corresponding grey slots.
